steps.text: 'Iwona, what do you fight for?'

a.text: 'To become a glorious campaign knight, of course. To take on the strong, protect the weak, and make a name for myself!'

steps.text: Upon hearing Iwona's answer, her parents laughed with satisfaction. Her visiting uncle cheerfully patted her head.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There's just one last Infected to contact on the list? Already?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Of course. You know how quick I work.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Great.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Anybody else you need me to get in touch with? Lemme take care of it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Nope, we're good for today.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After you contact this Mr. Kalisz, you can take the rest of the afternoon off.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Time off? Naw, I don't need any of that.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona, getting proper rest is important too!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Wait, is that... a campaign knight?)
A campaign knight stands before a newsstand not too far away, and Iwona naturally comes to a stop when she sees him.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: ...That'll be...

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: ...Not this one... Umm...
Seeing that he's in a bit of a pinch, she quickly strides forward without a second thought.
She wasn't able to personally witness the Silverlance Pegasi entering the city on the night of the power outage, but the flood of news and photos that followed stirred her heart.
For her, it was a bolt from the blue that pierced through Kazimierz's neon skyline.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona, something came up. Talk to you later!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But you're supposed to be taking a break—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I know! After I get ahold of Mr. Kalisz, I'll make sure to do nothing else this afternoon!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Okay, see you!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Calm down, Iwona. Calm down.)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Good day. Do you need some help?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I am—
Up close, Iwona can now clearly see the source of the campaign knight's hesitation – two lottery tickets.
A campaign knight. Gambling.
Two things she'd never imagined could mix.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...I am Iwona Krukowska, an Infected competition knight.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sorry for bothering you. I'll be on my way now, if there's nothing urgent I can help with.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: One moment, please. Do you know anything about this type of lotto–

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not familiar with that stuff... Goodbye.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Why would a dignified campaign knight be buying lotto tickets? Seems kinda sketchy for someone like that.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Well, whatever. None of my business.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Maybe he was just curious because he'd never seen stuff like that. Yeah, that's gotta be it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Let's see... Mr. Kalisz is supposed to live somewhere around here...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Mr. Kalisz?!

steps.name: Kalisz
steps.text: I-Iwona...
The man she was looking for is collapsed in his own doorway, moaning as he clutches the wound on his leg, blood gushing between his fingers.
There is nobody nearby to help him. Nor does anyone dare step forward to help the injured Infected, for obvious reasons.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Did the Armorless Union do this?

steps.name: Kalisz
steps.text: (Nods in pain)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Where'd they go?

steps.name: Kalisz
steps.text: (Points towards the depths of the alley)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Dammit!
Iwona urgently bandages his wound, then tightly grips her lance.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm gonna go settle the score–
As soon as those words leave her mouth, it suddenly dawns on her – is it really a good idea to leave him alone after he was just attacked? An Infected person, at that.

The old Wild Mane Knight would never have considered this: all she'd ever wanted was to charge at her enemies lance-first. But now, things were different. Now she's Wild Mane of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub.
But if she let the assassins get away, wouldn't that endanger both herself and Mr. Kalisz?
Right at that moment, she sees someone pass by the entrance to the alley.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey– Do you hear me? Hello?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Iwona Kru... Miss Krukowska? Did you need something–

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: This man... Who did this to him?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Armorless Union. I'm about to go teach them a lesson. Can I leave Mr. Kalisz to you?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Sure thing. Wait a sec– is he also Infected, like you?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So what if he is?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Then I have to be extra careful not to come in contact with his blood, right?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Go show those sewage-sucking pests what for! I'll take care of him!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Appreciate it!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Take him to a Pinus Sylvestris safe house, please! He knows the way!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: This card has our knightclub's crest. Show it to the people there, and they'll know what happened!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You've got nowhere to run!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: ...You're pretty quick on your feet, girl.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Why did you attack Mr. Kalisz?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: First, I don't know either.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Second, I know who you are, Wild Mane.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Seems like you got into a pretty big brawl with my colleagues earlier, but that's none of my business.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Also, you ought to get your temper under control, for your own sake. We weren't after that guy's life, yet you've chosen to wade into these murky waters yourself?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Just shut up and face me, asshole!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: I'll admit, I'm no match for you. But you were never one of my targets to begin with.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You were about to skip town too, so why bring all this extra trouble on yourself?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: How'd you know we were leaving?!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You are public figures, after all.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: A good while ago, I even placed a few bets on you. Lost quite a bit of money on that–

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Who cares?! I'm here because of what you did to Kalisz!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Even if you're just following orders, does your trigger finger not shake even a little bit when you're indiscriminately pointing your weapon at innocents?!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Of course my fingers are shaking. I'm absolutely terrified, young lady. So, would you mind letting me go now?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm not after your head. What I want is—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: An apology!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: For Mr. Kalisz!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: If that's the case, I'm not sure what to tell you.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: All I can say is, you're very fortunate to have met Flametail's crew.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: If you'd all come together, you might have been able to keep your life.
The Armorless Union member's presence diminishes.
Iwona's instincts, honed through countless battles, tell her that–

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Someone's firing arrows?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Where are they hiding? I need to flush them out–
The arrows from the hidden assassins take aim at her vitals, forcing her to constantly dodge.
Then, she sees the person she had just cornered take out a bow and aim it squarely between her eyes–

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Reveal yourselves, you vermin squirming in the shadows!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...The campaign knight?!

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: We do not defend Kazimierz to provide a breeding ground for your corruption!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: A campaign knight?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Iwona, don't let them catch you off-guard.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Monitor any movements in your surroundings. We need to get out of here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmhmm! The campaign knight brought Mr. Kalisz over, and Rhodes Island's Doctor is here too. You're in good hands now!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After how hard you've been working, you really deserve that afternoon break!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sorry, but what should I call you?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Marsov will do.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Thank you so much, Sir Marsov. I really mean it!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: No need to be so polite. I just happened to be passing by while on vacation, and decided to lend a hand.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Nobody wants to see Armorless Union filth while on their day off, right?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Haha, that's for sure!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Speaking of, I happen to have the afternoon off, so why don't we find someplace to have a drink?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Hm, a drink?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's right! I'll foot the bill!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Hmm, I suppose... I can do that.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Alrighty! Time to hit the pubs!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Okay... Gotta say, I was expecting somewhere more crowded. Lively? Why'd you take me to a bar with hardly any people?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I... prefer quieter places.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hmm, well, I guess that's fine too.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But man, they've got the good stuff here. Cheers!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Cheers.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: This liquor is quite good.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Marsov, on the night the campaign knights entered Kawalerielki, I was fighting the Armorless Union and didn't get to see you guys in person.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But I kept up with every bit of news after that! It was the coolest thing ever!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What Kawalerielki needs is more people like you, unafraid to tear off the masks off those two-faced backstabbers and stomp them into the ground!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You know what those hotshots in the General Chamber think of us Infected knights?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I'm not sure what you're asking. Aren't you just competition knights who happen to have Oripathy?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hmph. If normal competition knights are their puppets, we're even less than that. We're nothing but tattered rags to them!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Every time something goes wrong with the competitions, they always find a way to blame some unrelated Infected knight!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And when they want to brag about how well they treat the Infected, they shove us all on stage to show off the 'preferential treatment' we get... Just thinking about it makes me feel like my lungs are about to burst!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: How could they go and do that?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Take the Armorless Union. Ever since our Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub got a little famous, they've been knocking at our door nonstop, just because we don't want to get treated like trash by the G.C.C.!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: They nearly killed me on the night of the power outage, and my friends weren't any safer!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I've heard no shortage of rumors about the Armorless Union, but this is the first time I've seen them acting so brazenly in Kawalerielki.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's 'cause we're going up against them to help the Infected. They've been trying to get rid of us for a long time.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But there's no way we're gonna give up. As long as I draw breath, I won't sit back and watch as Kawalerielki chews us up and spits us out!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Hmm... It can't be that bad, can it?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: The Armorless Union and the G.C.C. might be despicable, but we're talking about Kawalerielki as a whole, here. At least the heart of Kazimierz is willing to look after the Infected, right?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Otherwise, they'd never have agreed to the Infected knights system in the first place.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The way you put that almost sounds like...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Bah, forget it. I don't wanna think about this. Drink up, drink up!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Pour me another glass, barkeep!

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Want it with ice? Maybe seltzer?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Give it to me straight.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Sure thing.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Here, one straight whiskey.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: That's good stuff.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Uhh... lemme get the same thing.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Want to add anything?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I also want it straight.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: This stuff's quite powerful undiluted, young lady.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I can handle it.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Alright then. Just one moment.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Phew, that's some good whiskey!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh right, Marsov, when I ran into you in the streets, I think you were checking out the lottos?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Lemme give you a word of advice. That stuff is a bottomless pit.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona told me before – those tickets are rigged.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You only have any real shot of winning the small prizes. Nobody's ever seen the so-called jackpot before! Oh, and some people bet on the matches too. Those are almost always fixed behind the scenes–

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: That's... That's a load of shit!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Last month, my cousin... Bought a ticket, and made a ton of money!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's the exception that proves the rule.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: I... I also bet on a lot of matches, and I've made some serious dosh!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But Sona said the people who give out the tickets have already done the math. You can never make back more money than you spent.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: A complete load of crap!

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: My cousin was real sick, and he only survived 'cause of that prize money!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's just a weird special case–

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: The hell are you talkin' about? Sounds like you're asking for a beating!

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Oh right, you said you're an Infected, didn't you?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Got a problem with that?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Infected scum... You should all get thrown out of Kawalerielki, so you stop polluting our streets.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Say that again to my face?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: What, is a filthy Infected gonna start a scene—
Iwona grabs the drunkard by the collar.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Say that again, I dare you!

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Hmph. What're you actin' all smug for...?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Knights these days are a joke. First, they let the Infected become competition knights; now, even campaign knights are mingling with 'em—
Marsov, who had been seated the entire time, abruptly stands up.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Sir, I will be holding you responsible for your slander against the campaign knights.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: 'Sir, I will be holding you responsible for your slander against the campaign knights.' Ahh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That line was SO badass!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Looks like you're way better at dealing with assholes like that than I am.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Those sorts of people can't tell chalk from cheese. Once they sober up, they'll remember what fear is.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Anyhow, like I was saying before we were rudely interrupted, you'd better not buy those lotto tickets. It's a scam the G.C.C. came up with to squeeze us of our hard-earned money.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I appreciate the advice. I'll try to avoid them.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: That said, they aren't entirely bad.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What are you talking about? What good could they possibly serve?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: At the very least, they offer a tiny bit of hope to pathetic men like him.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Woah, that's kinda... deep.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Hardly.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Because of that stupid gambling, people've been pushing me to fix my matches ever since I became an Infected knight.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: You must have been under a lot of pressure.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Maybe, but I've never caved to 'em even once! Haha!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If I win, I win. If I lose, I lose. I'm not gonna give up the glory of victory just for a few coins!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Well said. To the glory of victory!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: To the glory of victory!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Oh right, Iwona. What was your last name again?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I seem to vaguely recall hearing of other knights with that name before.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Krukowska.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Actually, some of my family also happen to be campa—

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: One second, let me take this call.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Marsov, didn't we agree to meet beneath Mieszko HQ? Where'd you go?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I... I had to take care of a little business.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: What kind of business?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Stop making shit up. We all saw you walk into a bar with some competition knight-looking chick!

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Never thought you of all people would fall so far.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: ...That's not true at all!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I'm heading over right now–

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Hahaha, don't worry about it. We're already outside the bar!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Your colleague?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Mm...hmm.
Marsov stands up stiffly and heads out the door.
Against the sunlight, Iwona sees three campaign knights waiting for him to leave.

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Playing the long game, are we, Marsov? Cozying up with a competition knight just to steal a drink?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I did nothing of the sort. Stop joking around like that.

steps.name: A Campaign Knight B
steps.text: Get out of there. Can't believe you'd slither into this den of commoners. We'll be lucky if you don't get a stomachache from that competition knight liquor.

steps.name: A Campaign Knight B
steps.text: Or don't tell me you've fallen in love with her, and plan to—

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Shut up already!

steps.name: A Campaign Knight C
steps.text: C'mon, stop messing with him. He must've had his reasons forcing him to consort with scum like her, the sort that parade around with the title of knight. Isn't that right, Marsov?
Marsov turns his head and looks at Iwona with embarrassment.
She is still shocked by their remarks, and has no time to respond to his pleading eyes.
He then turns back around.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: S-S-Stop making crass jokes like that!

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Oooh, and now he's getting angry.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Like hell I know who she is. She just grabbed me and forced me to drink with her!

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Who'd cozy up to a girl like that, so infatuated with campaign knights but can't even fit in with them?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I wouldn't have been drinking in a shithole like this in the first place if you guys hadn't been late!

steps.name: A Campaign Knight B
steps.text: Yeah right! We saw you happily chatting and laughing with her a moment ago.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I was just being polite. Besides, isn't the whole job of a competition knight to provide entertainment?

steps.name: A Campaign Knight C
steps.text: Alright, alright. We can talk about this later.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Marsov, why?!

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Ohoh? What's this? A card?

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Haha, never thought an honest-looking guy like you would have such a salacious move in his playbook.

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Is this how the two of you planned to secretly stay in touch? Something like the real letters appear when you hold it over a fire?

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Ridiculous!
Iwona sees Marsov throw the card bearing the crest of Pinus Sylvestris onto the ground, before viciously grinding his heel on it several times.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: I told you I was just having a bit of fun, but you guys won't listen.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: She's an Infected anyway. If she weren't stalking me, I'd never have come to a place like this.

steps.name: A Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Urgh, an Infected?

steps.name: A Campaign Knight B
steps.text: Tsk, tsk.

steps.name: Marsov
steps.text: Let's find a place that serves some proper wine. The swill in this shop is so vile that no decent person would be able to swallow it.
The campaign knights swagger away noisily.
Iwona remains frozen in place. The only thing she can think to do is to pick up the card from the ground.
Gray boot prints are imprinted on its surface, dense and overlapping.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So this... is a campaign knight?
Iwona thinks back to how he had acted from beginning to end.
Which one was the real Marsov?
He was willing to stand up for the safety of the Infected, and even to drink with an Infected knight he had only just met.
Yet, he also stomped on the card symbolizing her knightclub. He lied that she had stalked him, and belittled the competition knights by saying they were only good for entertainment.
He...

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: This is for you, girl.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: An extra-large mug of Żubrówka vodka?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I didn't order this...

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: This is the finest liquor I serve. It's on the house.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Don't worry too much about that guy. The hotshot knights are all like that.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You mean... him?

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Who else?

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Seeing you like this... Forget it, I'll pay for your drinks this time.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Why though?

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: You helped me drive away a mean drunk just now, didn't you? Treat it as fair payment.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: So enjoy your drink. After all, wasn't this bar opened specifically for people like us?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Alrighty!

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Whew, you downed that whole thing in one go?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: It'd be an insult if I didn't!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: After all, I've earned this afternoon off!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Still not sure how exactly to spend it, but I can't let it go to waste.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: *hic*.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Didn't we agree you'd take the afternoon off? Why are you back so soon?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Mutters incomprehensibly)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh, because you're smashed.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Did you hit the bars with that campaign knight?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I see. Go ahead and take a nap then.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Woah, she's already out cold.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: She's always had a high alcohol tolerance, and only lets herself get drunk when she's in a bad mood. I wonder what happened to get her like this?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hiyah!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What's wrong, Iwona?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: J-J-J-Justice Knight! Assemble!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Oh, she was just sleeptalking...)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The other day... I... wanted to paint you... sterling silver!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: Beep?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And then, ch-ch-change your name... to Silverlance Pegasus, Justice and Campaign Knight!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: Beep-beep-beep?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But I changed my mind! From now on... you'll just be Justice Knight, okay? No need to paint, no need for brushes!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: Beep...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Dismissed!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: Beep beep.
A small card falls out of Iwona's pocket, bearing the crest of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub along with a tessellation of boot prints.
As Sona comes to cover her with a blanket, the card does not escape her eyes.
When she connects the unfamiliar boot prints on the card to the contents of Iwona's sleeptalking, she has a rough idea of how she got drunk like this.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: 'What do I fight for?'

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (whispers) Iwona?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I want...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: to become a glorious...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Phew, that's some good whiskey!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Zzz... zzz...
Iwona turns over, stops talking in her sleep, and falls into a deep slumber.
Sona sighs, puts away the besmirched card, and slides a fresh, clean one into Iwona's pocket.
